purpose: Pilot variance and repetition planning for the current recipe, conditional on the already exposed 2024 calendar

training.refit: Fresh model on full permitted monthly training cohort, including already observed past2024; fixed selected inner epoch count; no warm start
training.batch_order: Deterministic generator seeded with stage seed+17; shuffled windows, chronology of sample construction remains intact

primary_metric: Annual pooled RMSE in original unannualized sigma7 units per seed trajectory
HPO: None; original family recipes remain fixed
epoch_rule: Inner early stopping followed by a fresh refit for exactly the selected inner epochs, separately in every month
seed_rule: base+100000*monthordinal; refit adds10000000; minibatch generator adds17
prior_exposure: 2023/2024 and original 2025-Aug2026 test have already been examined; this pilot adds fresh RNG trajectories only
independence: Five training randomizations conditional on one market/calendar; folds and dates are not independent market replications

dimensioning.correction: Conservative Bonferroni planning for twelve two-sided paired neural comparisons; future reporting may use Holm12
dimensioning.power_scope: Marginal per contrast under planning assumptions, not joint or achieved power
dimensioning.margin_timing: This absolute between-network margin is adopted now, anchored to the previous academic 5% persistence convention; not retroactively inherited by the old study
dimensioning.hypothesis: Detect a paired RMSE difference of magnitude delta against zero; not prove an improvement above a 5% boundary
dimensioning.exact_planning: Two-sided noncentral paired t under normal independent seed differences
dimensioning.R_definition: New definitive seed trajectories per model and history, excluding the five pilot seeds
dimensioning.future_seed_rule: If a new conditional-seed benchmark is authorized, use base seeds50000001..50000000+R; never pool pilot6201..6205 or choose seeds by outcome
dimensioning.uncertainty: Report point-SD R and common maximum R using a one-sided95% marginal chi-square upper SD; not a simultaneous variance guarantee
dimensioning.normality: Shapiro-Wilk and QQ are diagnostics only; five pairs cannot validate normality or final power
dimensioning.if_unidentifiable: Report limitation for zero/nonfinite dispersion or requiredR beyond search bound; do not silently cap or claim sufficiency
dimensioning.MDE: At pilotR5 and at the recommended commonR, using the same alpha and power assumptions

secondary_reference: Persistence RMSE is deterministic and descriptive here; neural-vs-persistence tests are not part of this primary family
advanced_policy_separate: The previous >5% versus MLP/D7 AND persistence policy requires its own advanced-method pilot and independent future evaluation
publication_scope: Aggregate metrics, plans, config metadata and hashes; individual predictions, scalers and weights retained privately
